title: Published client
what: The Rust client another repository reads pages through: the six operations over a data root, each answered in the wire format or refused with its code. bmo-artifact imports a page and a preview through it.

title: Unit command
what: The bmo-explorer words another process runs: mcp serves the MCP server over the data root, openapi prints the contract document, with their flags and exit codes.

title: Boundary API
what: Every API this repository offers other units: the published client, the MCP server's six tools, the placed tools with the web helper's socket, the site contract and the unit command. It serves no route of its own.

title: Harness plugin tools
what: The MCP server bmo-explorer mcp serves on standard input and output, its six explorer_ tools each a thin call of one client function, and the bmo-explorer skill a harness reads.

title: Site tool contract
what: The contract a site-tool repository builds on: the SiteTool trait, the roads a tool reaches its site by, the placed page wrapper and the web helper's socket, as docs/site-contract.md states them.

title: Placed tools
what: The tools a tool host places with their manifests, entries and claimed sites, and the shared web helper each record's tools ask on its socket. Lives in src/tools/ and tools/.
